prompts:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production UI icon atlas for an installable Calibre desktop icon theme, called Calibra Clay. Create ONE transparent PNG sprite atlas, square 1536x1536 or larger, EXACTLY 6 columns by 6 rows of 36 distinct icons. Each cell identical size. Icons centered exactly in their cells with 20% empty margin on every side, and no marks or objects crossing cell boundaries. No grid lines, captions, labels, background panels or watermarks.
Style: clay-style 3D icons, soft tactile plasticine texture with very fine fingerprints, rounded cute chunky proportions, warm pastel palette of peach, apricot, butter yellow, sage, dusty lavender and muted terracotta. Consistent orthographic three-quarter view, same scale, soft studio key light from upper left, subtle ambient occlusion and soft drop shadow toward lower right. Each object floats, shadows remain within its cell. Background genuinely transparent so icons work on clean light and dark Calibre interfaces. Simple readable silhouettes with few details.
Exact row-major subjects:
Row 1: closed sage book with peach plus badge (add books); peach document and lavender pencil (metadata); two chunky curved arrows forming a circle (convert); open cream book (read); sage paper airplane (send); lavender floppy disk (save).
Row 2: butter-yellow newspaper (news); three connected sage rounded nodes (share); terracotta waste bin (remove); lavender adjustment sliders (preferences); open peach book with pencil (edit book); golden sparkle cluster (polish).
Row 3: three upright pastel books (library); peach magnifying glass (search); sage hang tag (tags); stack of three pastel layers (series); lavender spiral notebook with tabs (catalog); peach shopping bag (store).
Row 4: sage human bust (authors); lavender puzzle piece (plugins); cream blank document with folded corner (file); butter-yellow folder (folder); lavender e-reader tablet (device); peach desktop monitor (computer).
Row 5: peach heart (donate); golden five-point star (rating); butter-yellow calendar (schedule); sage envelope (mail); lavender globe (languages); peach printer (print).
Row 6: rounded sage download arrow into tray (download); rounded peach upload arrow from tray (upload); butter-yellow open cardboard box (unpack); lavender interlocking chain link (link); peach sticky note (notes); sage cloud with downward arrow (download metadata).
Every cell contains one complete isolated standalone icon. Do not add any text.
